card.text: Explore Nereus in 3D with its published radar shape model.

introduction.text: Nereus is an elongated near-Earth asteroid reconstructed from radar observations around its 2002 encounter. This is the preferred smaller-volume model; its polar dimension is weakly constrained, and a thicker alternative fits comparably. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Radar shape model
shape.summary: Shape from radar observations. The gray grid marks missing optical imagery; lighting shows the model.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Radar height relative to a 165 m sphere. The polar thickness is uncertain; a thicker model also fits.
